strings.d1.s0.name: Römerberg
strings.d1.s0.tips: Reconstructed half-timbered square with the Römer town hall. Quiet before 09:30; Christmas market in December.
strings.d1.s1.name: Frankfurter Dom
strings.d1.s1.tips: The cathedral where emperors were crowned. Tower climb 3 EUR (328 steps).
strings.d1.s2.name: Kleinmarkthalle
strings.d1.s2.tips: Covered market from 1954 with 60+ stalls. Try Grüne Soße (green sauce with 7 herbs) and Frankfurter sausage, plus a wine stand upstairs. Closed Sunday.
strings.d1.s3.name: Main Tower
strings.d1.s3.tips: Observation deck at 200 m. Views of the 'Mainhattan' skyline and the Taunus.
strings.d1.s4.name: Eiserner Steg & Main Riverbank
strings.d1.s4.tips: Iron footbridge covered in love locks. Cross to Sachsenhausen and stroll the riverside promenade.
strings.d1.b0.name: Zum Gemalten Haus Sachsenhausen
strings.d1.b0.tips: Apfelwein (apple wine) tavern. Order Handkäs mit Musik.
strings.d1.b1.name: Historisches Museum Frankfurt
strings.d1.b1.tips: City history and models. Alternative to the tower climb.
strings.d2.s0.name: Städel Museum
strings.d2.s0.tips: 700 years of European art: Vermeer, Botticelli, Beckmann, Richter. Museumsufer ticket 21 EUR (34 museums, 2 days). Closed Tuesday.
strings.d2.s1.name: Städel Café Holbein's
strings.d2.s2.name: Liebieghaus
strings.d2.s2.tips: Sculpture museum in a villa, with a garden café.
strings.d2.s3.name: Deutsches Filmmuseum
strings.d2.s3.tips: Interactive history of cinema on Museumsufer.
strings.d2.s4.name: Museum Angewandte Kunst
strings.d2.s4.tips: Richard Meier's white design museum, with a park.
strings.d2.b0.name: Museum für Moderne Kunst MMK
strings.d2.b0.tips: Contemporary art in the 'slice of cake' building. Alternative to the Filmmuseum.
strings.d2.b1.name: Maincafé Sachsenhausen
strings.d2.b1.tips: Riverside café with a lawn. Best in summer.
strings.d3.s0.name: Heidelberg Castle
strings.d3.s0.tips: 1 hour by train (RE). Ruined red sandstone castle above the Neckar, with a funicular, the world's largest wine barrel and the Pharmacy Museum.
strings.d3.s1.name: Old Bridge
strings.d3.s1.tips: Stone bridge from 1788 with the monkey statue. Views toward the Philosophenweg.
strings.d3.s2.name: Zum Roten Ochsen
strings.d3.s2.tips: Student tavern from 1703. Mark Twain ate here too. Order the Schnitzel.
strings.d3.s3.name: Hauptstraße & Universitätsplatz
strings.d3.s3.tips: Germany's longest pedestrian street at 1.6 km. Visit the Student Jail (Studentenkarzer, 4 EUR).
strings.d3.s4.name: Philosophenweg
strings.d3.s4.tips: The Philosophers' Walk on the far bank of the Neckar. Postcard views of the castle and old town, then the train back.
strings.d3.b0.name: Königstuhl Bergbahn
strings.d3.b0.tips: Funicular up the 568 m hill, with views over the Rhine plain. Alternative to the road.
strings.d3.b1.name: Café Knösel Heidelberg
strings.d3.b1.tips: Café from 1863. Try the Heidelberger Studentenkuss chocolates.
strings.d4.s0.name: Palmengarten
strings.d4.s0.tips: Summer flowers and rowing boats on the pond. Concerts.
strings.d4.s1.name: Grüneburgpark
strings.d4.s1.tips: Former Rothschild park with a Korean garden and the IG Farben building (now the university).
strings.d4.s2.name: Senckenberg Naturmuseum
strings.d4.s2.tips: Germany's largest dinosaur collection, with a T. rex and Messel fossils.
strings.d4.s3.name: Bornheim Berger Straße
strings.d4.s3.tips: Café street in the 'Bernem' neighbourhood. Apfelwein at Solzer.
strings.d4.s4.name: Günthersburgpark
strings.d4.s4.tips: Neighbourhood park with a rose garden.
strings.d4.b0.name: Goethe House
strings.d4.b0.tips: Goethe's birthplace, in the centre. Alternative to Senckenberg.
strings.d4.b1.name: Apfelwein Solzer Bornheim
strings.d5.s0.name: Rüdesheim Drosselgasse
strings.d5.s0.tips: 1 hour by train (RB). A 144 m wine lane: touristy but charming.
strings.d5.s1.name: Niederwalddenkmal Cable Car
strings.d5.s1.tips: Cable car over the vineyards to the Germania monument and a bend of the Rhine, in the UNESCO Middle Rhine valley.
strings.d5.s2.name: Rüdesheimer Schloss Wine House
strings.d5.s2.tips: Riesling tasting and Rüdesheimer Kaffee (coffee with flambéed Asbach brandy).
strings.d5.s3.name: KD Rhine Boat Rüdesheim–St. Goar
strings.d5.s3.tips: Castle-lined Rhine cruise past the Loreley rock and Pfalzgrafenstein at Kaub (April to October).
strings.d5.s4.name: St. Goar & Burg Rheinfels
strings.d5.s4.tips: Town opposite the Loreley with a ruined fortress. Return train takes 1.5 hours.
strings.d5.b0.name: Kloster Eberbach
strings.d5.b0.tips: Cistercian monastery from 1136, with wine. Setting of The Name of the Rose film. Alternative to the boat.
strings.d5.b1.name: Breuer's Rüdesheimer Schloss Restaurant
strings.d5.b1.tips: The hotel's own restaurant. Try the Rhine fish.
strings.d6.s0.name: Höchst Altstadt
strings.d6.s0.tips: 15 minutes by S-Bahn. Half-timbered old town with the Justinuskirche (830), Bolongaro Palace and the Main ferry.
strings.d6.s1.name: Alt-Sachsenhausen Lunch Apfelwein Wagner
strings.d6.s1.tips: Apfelwein tavern from 1931. Schnitzel mit Grüner Soße at long shared tables.
strings.d6.s2.name: Sachsenhausen Cobbled Lanes
strings.d6.s2.tips: Klappergasse and the Kuhhirtenturm tower. The bar district in the evening.
strings.d6.s3.name: Museum Giersch
strings.d6.s3.tips: Art of the Rhine-Main region in a villa on Museumsufer.
strings.d6.s4.name: Frankfurt Flea Market Sachsenhausen
strings.d6.s4.tips: Saturday flea market on the Main riverbank (every 2 weeks). On other days, take a riverside walk.
strings.d6.b0.name: Adolf Wagner Apfelwein
strings.d6.b1.name: Ebbelwoi-Express Tram
strings.d6.b1.tips: Nostalgic tram tour with apple wine (weekends). Alternative to the lanes.
strings.d7.theme: Zeil and Opera: a gentle farewell
strings.d7.s0.name: Alte Oper
strings.d7.s0.tips: Opera house from 1880, with a fountain on the square.
strings.d7.s1.name: Zeil & MyZeil
strings.d7.s1.tips: Germany's busiest shopping street, with the glass-funnel MyZeil mall.
strings.d7.s2.name: Café Hauptwache
strings.d7.s2.tips: Café in the 1730 baroque guardhouse. A farewell stop.
strings.d7.s3.name: Hauptwache S-Bahn Airport
strings.d7.s3.tips: S8/S9 to the airport in 15 minutes. Farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Konstablerwache Farmers' Market
strings.d7.b0.tips: Market Thursday to Saturday, with an apfelwein stand.
strings.d7.b1.name: Eschenheimer Turm
strings.d7.b1.tips: Medieval tower from 1428. Alternative to the opera.
strings.note0: RMV day ticket 6 EUR (central zone). The airport is 15 minutes by S-Bahn (Europe's main hub). Take the RE train to Heidelberg and Rüdesheim; the Hessen-Ticket is cheap for groups.
strings.note1: Summer temperatures 25-30°C. Look out for the Museumsuferfest on the Main (August), apfelwein gardens, Rhine boats and the Rüdesheim wine festival in August.
strings.note2: Apfelwein 0.3 l 2.50 EUR (in a Bembel jug), Grüne Soße 12, Schnitzel 18, museums 8-18. To tip, round up the bill.
strings.note3: Museumsufer Ticket 21 EUR for 34 museums over 2 days. Städel closed Tuesday; Kleinmarkthalle closed Sunday; flea market on Saturday.
strings.note4: Bahnhofsviertel (the station district) has a drug problem: pass through by day and avoid it at night. Sachsenhausen is the bar district at night.
strings.note5: Frankfurter Würstchen, Handkäs mit Musik (cheese with onions), Bethmännchen (almond cookies), Frankfurter Kranz.
